text: dsh-web-ding 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示音插件：宿主端监听智能体状态从运行转为空闲，并通过设置镜像发送完成信号，浏览器端用 Web Audio 合成提示音。它也能检测用户选择弹窗并单独播放提示音；设置页可调整两类声音的开关、音量、频率和衰减时间，并提供试听。回合结束时还会显示通知并在浏览器本地保存最近记录，适合希望及时察觉后台任务完成的 Web 用户。首次播放前需在页面进行交互以解锁浏览器音频。

dsh-web-ding adds browser sound cues to DSH: the host signals agent turn completion and the web client plays a Web Audio ding. A separate cue marks question popups. Settings control both tones and provide previews; recent notices stay in browser storage. Click the page once to unlock audio.
想让 DSH 智能体跑完一轮时在浏览器里响一声
有没有办法知道后台任务什么时候结束，不必一直盯着页面
让浏览器在新的用户选择问题弹出时提醒我
我想分别调节任务完成提示音和问题弹窗提示音
给我一个能试听并设置提示音音量和音调的 DSH 网页设置面板
把每次智能体完成回合的通知保存在浏览器里方便回看
Play a sound in the browser whenever a DSH agent finishes a turn
Notify me when a question prompt appears in the web client
dsh-web-ding 的功能「turn-end」：回合结束提示音：检测智能体由非空闲状态转为空闲，并发布完成信号；浏览器收到较新的信号后播放可配置的 Web Audio 铃声。
dsh-web-ding 的功能「question-popup」：用户选择弹窗提示音：浏览器观察问题节点，新问题出现时按独立开关和音调设置播放提示音。
dsh-web-ding 的功能「settings」：提示音设置与试听：设置分区分别控制问题弹窗和回合结束声音的开关、音量、频率及衰减时间，并提供试听操作。
dsh-web-ding 的功能「history」：回合通知记录：完成时显示通知并将记录保存在浏览器 localStorage，最多保留 100 条，可逐条删除或清空。
dsh-web-ding 使用前须知：浏览器会阻止尚未由用户交互解锁的音频；先点击页面或试听按钮，之后才可听到提示音。（见 web/client.js:274-305）

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · dsh-web-ding：A DSH Cordis plugin that plays a **"ding"** in the **browser** the moment an
agent finishes (runs to idle). The sound is synthesized **entirely by front-end
JavaScript (Web Audio API)** — the Node/Host side never plays audio and no
Windows/system notification is used.

Built by following the architecture of
[dsh-force-compact](https://github.com/falling-ts/dsh-force-compact):
a pure-listener Host half + a browser client half connected by the official
`settings/document-updated` mirror channel.

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · What it does：| Layer | What happens |
|-------|--------------|
| Host (`index.js` + `src/`) | Listens for the `agent/status` **idle transition** (all turns done, including sub-agents, before the next human turn; a fresh idle session that never ran, and repeated idle ticks, stay silent). Publishes `{ phase:'done', at, sessionId, title }` into the `falling-ts-web-ding` settings namespace — `title` is read here from the official `sessionProjections` `title` unit, so the browser never has to fetch it. Never emits audio, never calls the OS. |
| Browser (`web/client.js`) | Mirrors the namespace live via `configForms`. On a strictly-newer `done` signal it synthesizes a short `ding` (three sine oscillators + exponential decay envelopes) with the Web Audio API and plays it through the tab — and, at the same moment, pops a Win11-style toast in the bottom-right corner. Clicking the toast slides in a notification drawer listing every turn-end message (kept in browser `localStorage`, capped at 100, deduped by signal `at`), with per-message delete and a clear-all button. Everything stays front-end: no backend audio, no OS notification. |

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:falling-ts/dsh-web-ding
```

Requires the web app to ship the client bundle (the `dsh.client` declaration in
`package.json` does that automatically).

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · Configuration (`falling-ts-web-ding` namespace, stored in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`)：Two independent blocks, each with its own switch and its own tone:

**Block 1 — 弹出用户选择 (question popup ding)** — plays when the harness pops a
user-question chooser in the browser. Detection is client-side on the DOM
(`[data-question-key]` anchor of the QuestionComposer): the Host half sees no
question frame, so this block is entirely browser-side.

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · Configuration (`falling-ts-web-ding` namespace, stored in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`)：| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|---------|
| `questionEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Switch for the question-popup ding. |
| `questionVolume` | number 0..1 | `0.7` | Web Audio playback gain. |
| `questionFreq` | number 80..4000 | `880` | Fundamental frequency of the ding (Hz). |
| `questionDecayMs` | number 100..4000 | `900` | Tone decay length (ms). |

auto-dismisses after 6 s). Click it to open the right-side notification
drawer: the last 100 turn-end messages are kept in the browser's
`localStorage` (key `falling-ts-web-ding.notify.v1`), each row can be
deleted individually, and a "全部删除" button clears them all. The message
log is front-end only — the Host never reads or writes it.

@falling-ts/dsh-web-ding README · Browser autoplay policy：Browsers block audio until a user gesture. The client warms the
`AudioContext` on the first pointer/key interaction (and on the preview
button), so: interact with the page once (or press 试听) and you will hear the
ding at every agent turn end. An audio context in a background tab may be
suspended by the browser itself — keep the tab visible to hear the tone.
